mapper.select: select account_id, phone_lookup_ref, status from accounts where account_id = #{accountId} for update
mapper.update: update practice_generated_content_evidence_bundles derived set derived_from_bundle_id = null where derived_from_bundle_id in ( select owned.evidence_bundle_id from practice_generated_content_evidence_bundles owned join practice_generated_content content on content.generated_content_id = owned.generated_content_id where content.account_id = #{accountId} and content.owner_scope in ('account', 'profile') )

update account_sessions set status = 'deleted', revoked_at = #{updatedAt}, installation_id = case when installation_id ~ '^v1:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' then installation_id else 'redacted' end where account_id = #{accountId} and status <> 'deleted'
update account_sessions set installation_id = 'redacted' where account_id = #{accountId} and installation_id !~ '^v1:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$'
update consent_audit_logs set installation_id = 'redacted' where account_id = #{accountId} and installation_id !~ '^v1:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$'

with candidates as ( select distinct on (household.household_id) household.household_id, member.account_id as new_owner_account_id from households household join household_members member on member.household_id = household.household_id and member.account_id <> #{accountId} and member.status = 'active' join accounts candidate_account on candidate_account.account_id = member.account_id and candidate_account.status = 'active' where household.owner_account_id = #{accountId} order by household.household_id, (member.role = 'primary_caregiver') desc, member.joined_at asc, member.account_id asc ), updated as ( update households household set owner_account_id = candidate.new_owner_account_id from candidates candidate where household.household_id = candidate.household_id returning household.household_id, household.owner_account_id ) update household_members member set role = 'primary_caregiver' from updated where member.household_id = updated.household_id and member.account_id = updated.owner_account_id and member.status = 'active'

update accounts set status = 'deleted', phone_lookup_ref = concat('deleted:', account_id), phone_mask = '账号已删除', latest_consent_status = 'deleted', deleted_at = #{deletedAt} where account_id = #{accountId} and status = 'active'
